question: How should all these procedures be performed and with what special accompaniment?
premises: All the enumerated procedures must be performed
They should be done in the manner of āvarta
They must be accompanied by two root elements
inference: One should perform all as in āvarta, but endowed with the two root elements.
uncertainties: The identity of the two root elements (mūla dvaya) is not specified
plain_english: One should perform all of this as in āvarta, but endowed with the two root elements.
